result.brief: 研究在冻结的 Drive-JEPA 端到端驾驶规划器中引入可验证场景事实推理，并用规则化事实校验使干预可审计。
result.reason: Uses frozen Drive-JEPA planner with VLM scene facts and tests whether reasoning influences planning; involves JEPA-style representation and driving world-model planning, though main contribution is planner integration.
